answer: In PoA, every identity locks bonded collateral in an escrow, while attestations, timing, and funding expose coordination. When k identities equivocate together, correlated evidence triggers penalties scaling as O(k^2), rather than k isolated fines. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation reducing recoverable stake across linked escrows. Thus a nebula of aliases, whether juniper-backed or hollow-funded, cannot cheaply replenish a detected sybil swarm.
